items.headline: Brazilian Grand Prix

items.body: Round 20 of the Formula 1 season. Won by Lando Norris (McLaren) from Max Verstappen and Isack Hadjar.
facts: Lando Norris won from the pit lane, 14.6 seconds ahead of Max Verstappen

Rain fell during the race
Norris's tyres: intermediate then soft then soft then intermediate, 3 stops

facts: Marco Bezzecchi won by 3.1 seconds from Marc Marquez

Marc Marquez set a new lap record, 1:52.558

editions.title: This weekend on E-Grid
editions.intro: Five rounds across five championships this week: a WEC night race in the Gulf, a Clio Cup visit to Portugal, and the season finales of Formula 1, MotoGP and NASCAR.

items.headline: 8 Hours of Bahrain
items.detail: Bahrain International Circuit · Sat 7 Nov
items.body: The World Endurance Championship closes its campaign with the eight hours at the Bahrain International Circuit on Saturday. It is a full-distance test that runs through the night.

items.headline: Portimão
items.detail: Autódromo Internacional do Algarve, Portugal · Sun 8 Nov
items.body: The Clio Cup Series reaches Portugal for its seventh round at the Autódromo Internacional do Algarve on Sunday. It is a compact circuit that packs plenty of racing into a short lap.

items.headline: Brazilian Grand Prix
items.detail: Autódromo José Carlos Pace, Brazil · Sun 8 Nov
items.body: Round twenty brings Formula 1 to the Autódromo José Carlos Pace in Brazil on Sunday, with qualifying on Saturday at 18:00 UTC and the race itself starting at 17:00 UTC. Andrea Kimi Antonelli arrives with a comfortable 119-point championship lead over Max Verstappen.
facts: Qualifying Sat 7 Nov, 18:00 UTC
Andrea Kimi Antonelli leads the championship by 119 points from Max Verstappen

items.headline: Grand Prix of Qatar
items.detail: Lusail International Circuit, Qatar · Sun 8 Nov
items.body: Sunday's Grand Prix of Qatar at the Lusail International Circuit is round twenty of the MotoGP season. Marc Marquez leads the standings by 44 points from Jorge Martin as they arrive here.
facts: Marc Marquez leads the championship by 44 points from Jorge Martin

lastRaces.headline: 8 Hours of Bahrain
lastRaces.body: The 8 Hours of Bahrain served as round eight of the World Endurance Championship, staged on Saturday 7 November at the Bahrain International Circuit. It was a demanding endurance test that brought the series back to the desert for its latest round.

lastRaces.headline: Las Vegas Nationals
lastRaces.detail: Las Vegas Motor Speedway · Sun 1 Nov
lastRaces.body: The Las Vegas Nationals brought drag racing to Las Vegas Motor Speedway on Sunday 1 November. Drivers lined up across the weekend for a full day of quarter-mile action, chasing speed and consistency down the strip.

lastRaces.headline: Xfinity 500
lastRaces.body: William Byron claimed the Xfinity 500 at Martinsville, beating teammate Chase Elliott into second with Ty Gibbs third. Starting from eighth, he led 362 of 500 laps and swept stages one and two to win by just over two seconds. His performance narrowed Kyle Larson's Chase lead over Christopher Bell from 73 to 67 points, with a single race remaining.
facts: William Byron won from 8th on the grid and led 362 of 500 laps
William Byron swept stages 1 and 2
Margin of victory: 2.049 s
Kyle Larson's Chase lead over Christopher Bell went from 73 to 67 points this weekend, with 1 race to go
The win lifted William Byron from 11th to 9th in the Chase
500 laps, 11 lead changes among 6 drivers

lastRaces.headline: Navarra
lastRaces.detail: Circuito de Navarra, Spain · Sun 18 Oct
lastRaces.body: Round six of the Clio Cup Series ran at the Circuito de Navarra in Spain on Sunday 18 October. Drivers took to the short Spanish circuit for another leg of the championship.

lastRaces.headline: Rally Italia Sardegna
lastRaces.body: World Rally Championship's Rally Italia Sardegna came around Alghero in Italy on Sunday 4 October, forming round 13 of the season. It was another demanding test across Sardinia for the leading crews as they pressed on through the latter half of the calendar.

lastRaces.headline: Motul Petit Le Mans
lastRaces.detail: Michelin Raceway Road Atlanta · Sat 3 Oct
lastRaces.body: IMSA's SportsCar Championship reaches its finale with the Motul Petit Le Mans at Michelin Raceway Road Atlanta on Saturday 3 October. The endurance marathon has long stood as the series' crowning event, capping another demanding season of sports car racing.

lastRaces.headline: Baku
lastRaces.detail: Baku City Circuit, Azerbaijan · Sun 27 Sep
lastRaces.body: Formula 2 brought its sprint and feature races to the Baku City Circuit in Azerbaijan on Sunday 27 September. The narrow street track threading the old city's walls offered another tight, technical test for the feeder series.

lastRaces.headline: Madrid
lastRaces.body: Formula 3's tenth round came to Madrid, Spain on Sunday 13 September. The championship's Spanish round brought its racing to the city that weekend.

lastRaces.headline: Monza (double-header)
lastRaces.detail: Autodromo Nazionale Monza, Italy · Sun 6 Sep
lastRaces.body: Autodromo Nazionale Monza has hosted racing since 1922, its 5.793 km lap threading through 11 corners. The Porsche Supercup's seventh round ran here on Sunday 6 September as a double-header in Italy.
facts: 5.793 km lap, 11 corners, first raced 1922

lastRaces.headline: Season Finale
lastRaces.detail: WeatherTech Raceway Laguna Seca · Sun 6 Sep
lastRaces.body: IndyCar's season finale reached WeatherTech Raceway Laguna Seca on Sunday 6 September. As the championship's final round of the year, it brought the season to a close at the venue.

lastRaces.headline: London E-Prix
lastRaces.body: Taylor Barnard won in London for DS Penske, completing a Mahindra Racing one-two as Nyck De Vries took second and Edoardo Mortara third. The result leaves Pascal Wehrlein five points clear at the top of the championship, ahead of Jake Dennis.
facts: Pascal Wehrlein leads the championship by 5 points from Jake Dennis
